name: Death Summary
description: The run's obituary. On the killing blow it assembles the record — depth reached, drafts taken, the build snapshot, the cause of death — from the systems that own those facts, and presents the credits progression.run_meta_progression granted so the player watches death convert into progress instead of watching a fade to black. Depth comes from world.floor_descent, credits from run_meta_progression, and this component owns only the assembly and presentation, because a summary that computes its own stats is a second source of truth that will eventually disagree with the first. It does not own the death — combat.damage_resolver decided that — and it does not own the memorial: what the game does with the fallen after the summary is shown is its own design call.

inputs.name: showCauseOfDeath
inputs.description: Names the killer and the final blow. Off only for tone — the data is collected regardless, because telemetry should not depend on a UI toggle.

inputs.name: includeBuildSnapshot
inputs.description: Whether the summary records the final build (relics, drafts, loadout). The snapshot is what makes a death a lesson instead of an ending.

outputs.name: lastRunSummary
outputs.description: The full record: depth, kills, build snapshot, cause of death, credits granted. Kept so a post-run share card or replay browser can read it without re-deriving anything.
